mention-194ad35e98b1396a9d84c97f.required_result: Listing scans the same caller scope positions per retained record, independent of which scope matches, while returning only visible IDs.
mention-194ad35e98b1396a9d84c97f.gap: The maintained visibleExecutions leaf checks only a positive read count and visible-ID shape. It does not assert equal read counts for early/late/no-match scans. The single-ID lookup leaves do not execute the listing path.
mention-194ad35e98b1396a9d84c97f.planned_test: A separate kernel scope-listing regression compares equal-size early-match, late-match and no-match scope arrays over the same record population and checks returned IDs, then binds it through P1. No product change; stop if it fails.

mention-bc970277f23ef1e97995b21f.required_result: Creation and ingress reuse each observed envelope field for validation, authority, identity and retained content; a shifting getter cannot validate one value and commit another.
mention-bc970277f23ef1e97995b21f.gap: The source requires single observation across scope authorization, key packing and retained creation/ingress fields. The current ordering leaf uses stable scope values; payload mutation and Outcome field-count leaves test different inputs/paths. A bounded search of packages/kernel/tests and packages/sdk/tests found no shifting-getter matrix asserting each creation/ingress field count and its retained first value. Source reading therefore cannot retire this obligation on those weaker pointers.
mention-bc970277f23ef1e97995b21f.planned_test: Exercise shifting own getters on creation scope/key/pins/initial input fields and ingress key/kind/subscription/payload, count observations, and inspect/replay the retained result. Use core byte roots directly; stop if a new regression exposes a product defect.
